text: From step 6000 to 12000 at N=128, force gains only about 0.02-0.03 per decade of val_mse_ratio decline, against about 0.05 per decade in the d128/5000-step seed-75 run. Is force gain per decade of log val_mse_ratio set by steps_per_orbit or by model width, and does it fall to zero once val_mse_ratio is below about 0.02?
